data.body: [P2] Preserve the existing public record shape. Adding an eighth component breaks recompilation of Java 21+ consumers using seven-component `InvocationInfo` record patterns. The added compatibility test explicitly expects this compilation failure; retaining constructors preserves constructor calls but leaves this source regression. Keep the seven-component record and carry the header through separate immutable hook metadata with a backward-compatible default hook overload. Update the compatibility test to require the existing pattern to compile successfully.
